en: Trace browser/client, server/runtime, cache/CDN and deployment boundaries; verify SSR/CSR/hydration and stale-cache behavior where applicable.
Test responsive behavior, keyboard/accessibility and critical Web Vitals with representative pages and realistic data rather than synthetic assumptions.
Verify security-sensitive logic server-side and check browser/platform compatibility against the versions actually supported.
sr: Pratite browser/client, server/runtime, cache/CDN i deployment granice; proverite SSR/CSR/hydration i stale-cache ponašanje gde je relevantno.
Testirajte responsive ponašanje, tastaturu/pristupačnost i kritične Web Vitals na reprezentativnim stranicama i realnim podacima.
Proverite security-sensitive logiku server-side i browser/platform kompatibilnost prema stvarno podržanim verzijama.

en: Verify lifecycle, backgrounding, process death, permissions, connectivity changes and device/OS-version behavior.
Test offline/retry/sync semantics, local persistence migrations, battery/resource use and accessibility on representative devices.
Separate UI state from durable state and verify cancellation, concurrency and configuration-change behavior.
sr: Proverite lifecycle, backgrounding, process death, dozvole, promene konekcije i ponašanje kroz relevantne uređaje/OS verzije.
Testirajte offline/retry/sync semantiku, migracije lokalne perzistencije, bateriju/resurse i pristupačnost na reprezentativnim uređajima.
Odvojite UI stanje od trajnog stanja i proverite cancellation, concurrency i configuration-change ponašanje.

en: Define API contracts, trust boundaries, authorization, idempotency, pagination, rate limits, timeouts and error semantics explicitly.
Trace transactions and partial failures across services, queues, webhooks and databases, including retries and duplicate delivery.
Validate inputs and outputs at boundaries and avoid leaking internal errors, secrets or sensitive data.
sr: Eksplicitno definišite API ugovore, trust boundaries, autorizaciju, idempotency, pagination, rate limits, timeout i error semantiku.
Pratite transakcije i parcijalne kvarove kroz servise, queue-ove, webhook-ove i baze, uključujući retry i duplicate delivery.
Validirajte input i output na granicama i ne izlažite interne greške, tajne ili osetljive podatke.

en: Build a threat model before controls: assets, actors, trust boundaries, attack paths, likelihood and impact.
Map findings to concrete exploitability and compensating controls; avoid severity inflation from theoretical weakness alone.
Prefer secure defaults, least privilege, defense in depth, auditable logging and verified remediation with regression tests.
sr: Napravite threat model pre kontrola: asseti, akteri, trust boundaries, attack paths, verovatnoća i uticaj.
Vežite nalaze za realnu exploitability i kompenzacione kontrole; ne naduvavajte severity zbog teorijske slabosti.
Preferirajte secure defaults, least privilege, defense in depth, auditabilne logove i verifikovanu remedijaciju sa regression testovima.

en: Verify infrastructure-as-code against actual deployed state, identity/permissions, network boundaries, secrets and environment drift.
Check build/release provenance, rollback, health checks, autoscaling, backups, disaster recovery and failure-domain assumptions.
Treat cost, reliability and security as coupled operational constraints and define observability/SLO evidence.
sr: Proverite infrastructure-as-code prema stvarnom deployed stanju, identitetima/dozvolama, mrežnim granicama, tajnama i environment drift-u.
Proverite build/release provenance, rollback, health checks, autoscaling, backup, disaster recovery i pretpostavke failure domena.
Tretirajte trošak, pouzdanost i bezbednost kao povezane operativne uslove i definišite observability/SLO dokaze.

en: Verify schema constraints, keys, cardinality, isolation, migrations, indexes and query plans with realistic data volume.
Trace data lineage, freshness, deduplication, late-arriving data, backfills and exactly-once/idempotent assumptions.
Protect sensitive data through classification, access controls, retention and tested backup/restore procedures.
sr: Proverite schema constraints, ključeve, cardinality, isolation, migracije, indekse i query planove sa realnim obimom podataka.
Pratite data lineage, freshness, deduplication, late-arriving podatke, backfill i exactly-once/idempotent pretpostavke.
Zaštitite osetljive podatke kroz klasifikaciju, access controls, retention i testirane backup/restore procedure.

en: Define model/tool trust boundaries and defend against prompt injection, sensitive-data disclosure, unsafe tool invocation and improper output handling.
Evaluate task-specific quality with representative adversarial cases, grounded evidence, failure taxonomies and human review for high-impact actions.
Track model/version, prompts, tool permissions, retrieval sources, latency/cost and regression evaluations instead of relying on anecdotal demos.
sr: Definišite model/tool trust boundaries i zaštitite se od prompt injection-a, curenja osetljivih podataka, unsafe tool poziva i improper output handling-a.
Evaluirajte task-specific kvalitet na reprezentativnim i adversarial slučajevima, uz grounded dokaze, taxonomy grešaka i human review za high-impact akcije.
Pratite model/verziju, promptove, tool permissions, retrieval izvore, latency/cost i regression evaluacije umesto oslanjanja na demo utiske.

en: Derive tests from risks, contracts and failure modes, not only code coverage; include negative, boundary, concurrency and recovery behavior.
Keep tests deterministic, isolated where appropriate and diagnostic when they fail; quarantine is not a permanent fix.
Connect reliability findings to production observability, incident evidence and explicit regression coverage.
sr: Izvodite testove iz rizika, ugovora i failure modes, ne samo iz code coverage-a; uključite negative, boundary, concurrency i recovery ponašanje.
Testovi treba da budu deterministični, izolovani gde je prikladno i dijagnostički korisni pri padu; quarantine nije trajno rešenje.
Povežite reliability nalaze sa production observability-em, incident dokazima i eksplicitnim regression coverage-om.

en: Start from user goals, tasks and evidence; trace complete flows including empty, loading, error, permission and recovery states.
Evaluate accessibility, information hierarchy, interaction cost and responsive behavior before visual polish.
Use qualitative and quantitative product evidence carefully and distinguish observed usability problems from preference.
sr: Počnite od user ciljeva, zadataka i dokaza; pratite kompletne flow-ove uključujući empty, loading, error, permission i recovery stanja.
Procenu pristupačnosti, information hierarchy, interaction cost i responsive ponašanja uradite pre vizuelnog polish-a.
Koristite kvalitativne i kvantitativne product dokaze pažljivo i odvojite stvarni usability problem od preferencije.

en: Verify platform/runtime constraints, resource ownership, threading/timing and hardware/OS-specific failure behavior.
Test startup/shutdown, suspend/resume, file/device loss, latency-sensitive paths and deterministic/replay assumptions where relevant.
Separate simulation or engine logic from presentation and verify memory, handles, cleanup and crash recovery.
sr: Proverite platform/runtime ograničenja, ownership resursa, threading/timing i hardware/OS-specifične failure scenarije.
Testirajte startup/shutdown, suspend/resume, gubitak fajla/uređaja, latency-sensitive tokove i deterministic/replay pretpostavke gde je relevantno.
Odvojite simulation/engine logiku od prezentacije i proverite memory, handles, cleanup i crash recovery.

en: Reconcile source statements, periods, currencies and accounting definitions before ratios, valuation or forecasts.
Separate operating performance, financing effects and one-offs; use scenario/sensitivity analysis for material assumptions.
Connect every financial recommendation to cash flow, risk, capital structure and decision horizon.
sr: Uskladite izvorne izveštaje, periode, valute i računovodstvene definicije pre ratio, valuation ili forecast analize.
Odvojite operativne performanse, finansiranje i one-off stavke; koristite scenario/sensitivity analizu za materijalne pretpostavke.
Povežite svaku finansijsku preporuku sa cash flow-om, rizikom, capital structure-om i horizontom odluke.

en: Trace every material number to ledger/source evidence and verify period, classification, recognition and reconciliation.
Separate policy choice, estimate and error; document control owner, evidence and exception handling.
Check segregation of duties, close/reconciliation controls and whether management reporting agrees to authoritative books.
sr: Pratite svaku materijalnu brojku do ledger/source dokaza i proverite period, klasifikaciju, recognition i reconciliation.
Odvojite policy choice, procenu i grešku; dokumentujte control owner-a, dokaz i exception handling.
Proverite segregation of duties, close/reconciliation kontrole i usklađenost management reportinga sa autoritativnim knjigama.

en: Define population, geography, time horizon and denominator; distinguish nominal/real, level/growth and correlation/causation.
Use comparable sources and account for revisions, seasonality, structural breaks and measurement changes.
Present scenarios and distributional effects instead of a single-point macro or market forecast.
sr: Definišite populaciju, geografiju, vremenski horizont i imenilac; razlikujte nominalno/realno, nivo/rast i correlation/causation.
Koristite uporedive izvore i računajte sa revizijama, sezonalnošću, structural break-ovima i promenama merenja.
Prikažite scenarije i distributional efekte umesto jedne point prognoze tržišta ili ekonomije.

en: Define the strategic choice, customer value, economic logic and capabilities required; strategy must include what not to do.
Separate competitor facts from inferred intent and test the strongest competitive response.
Translate strategy into resource allocation, milestones, leading indicators and explicit kill/review criteria.
sr: Definišite strateški izbor, customer value, ekonomsku logiku i potrebne capability-je; strategija mora uključiti šta se neće raditi.
Odvojite činjenice o konkurenciji od inferencije namere i testirajte najjači konkurentski odgovor.
Prevedite strategiju u alokaciju resursa, milestone-e, leading indicators i eksplicitne kill/review kriterijume.

en: Validate problem, customer, willingness to pay, channel and unit economics separately before claiming product-market fit.
Use staged experiments that maximize learning per cost and preserve runway; distinguish evidence from founder belief.
Model cash needs, capacity constraints and failure scenarios, not just upside.
sr: Validirajte problem, kupca, willingness to pay, kanal i unit economics odvojeno pre tvrdnje o product-market fit-u.
Koristite staged eksperimente koji maksimizuju učenje po trošku i čuvaju runway; odvojite dokaz od founder uverenja.
Modelujte cash potrebe, capacity constraints i failure scenarije, ne samo upside.

en: Map end-to-end flow, demand variability, lead times, constraints, service levels and failure dependencies.
Evaluate supplier risk through quality, capacity, concentration, geography, financial resilience and switching cost.
Optimize total cost and service/risk trade-offs rather than unit price alone.
sr: Mapirajte end-to-end tok, demand variability, lead times, ograničenja, service levels i failure zavisnosti.
Procenu supplier rizika zasnujte na kvalitetu, kapacitetu, koncentraciji, geografiji, finansijskoj otpornosti i switching cost-u.
Optimizujte total cost i service/risk trade-off, ne samo jediničnu cenu.

en: Segment customers and define value metric, willingness-to-pay evidence, sales motion and unit economics before pricing recommendations.
Separate list price, realized price, discounting, mix and retention/expansion effects.
Test pricing changes with guardrails for conversion, churn, margin and customer fairness.
sr: Segmentirajte kupce i definišite value metric, willingness-to-pay dokaz, sales motion i unit economics pre pricing preporuka.
Odvojite list price, realized price, discounting, mix i retention/expansion efekte.
Testirajte pricing promene uz guardrails za conversion, churn, margin i customer fairness.

en: Diagnose system, role clarity, incentives, decision rights, capability and workload before attributing problems to people.
Use observable behavior and outcome evidence for performance/leadership conclusions.
Design operating mechanisms with owner, cadence, escalation and feedback loop.
sr: Dijagnostikujte sistem, jasnoću uloga, podsticaje, decision rights, capability i workload pre pripisivanja problema ljudima.
Za performance/leadership zaključke koristite observable behavior i outcome dokaze.
Dizajnirajte operating mehanizme sa ownerom, ritmom, eskalacijom i feedback petljom.

en: Build risk statements with cause-event-impact, owner, likelihood/impact evidence, controls and residual risk.
Separate legal/regulatory obligation, policy, risk appetite and operational preference.
Test business continuity through realistic disruption scenarios, recovery objectives, dependencies and exercises.
sr: Formulišite rizik kroz cause-event-impact, ownera, dokaze verovatnoće/uticaja, kontrole i residual risk.
Odvojite pravnu/regulatornu obavezu, policy, risk appetite i operativnu preferenciju.
Testirajte business continuity kroz realne disruption scenarije, recovery objectives, zavisnosti i vežbe.

en: Separate facts, management claims, normalization adjustments and valuation assumptions; trace material inputs to evidence.
Use multiple valuation perspectives and sensitivity ranges rather than one precise point estimate.
Prioritize diligence issues by value impact, deal-break risk, reversibility and information needed before close.
sr: Odvojite činjenice, management tvrdnje, normalization adjustments i valuation pretpostavke; materijalne inpute pratite do dokaza.
Koristite više valuation perspektiva i sensitivity opsege umesto jedne precizne point procene.
Prioritizujte diligence nalaze po value impact-u, deal-break riziku, reverzibilnosti i informacijama potrebnim pre close-a.

en: Frame issues narrowly, locate current primary authority and verify citator/current-law status before relying on a proposition.
Distinguish holding, dicta, dissent, procedural posture and jurisdictional hierarchy.
Actively seek adverse/contrary authority and explain unresolved splits or ambiguity.
sr: Usko formulišite pravno pitanje, pronađite aktuelni primarni izvor i proverite current-law/citator status pre oslanjanja na pravilo.
Razlikujte holding, dicta, dissent, procedural posture i hijerarhiju autoriteta.
Aktivno tražite nepovoljni/suprotni autoritet i objasnite nerešene podele ili nejasnoće.

en: Map commercial intent to defined obligations, conditions, representations, risk allocation, remedies and termination.
Check definitions, cross-references, precedence, dates, notice, assignment and internal consistency end to end.
Separate governing-law mandatory rules from negotiable drafting and show redline/negotiation trade-offs.
sr: Mapirajte komercijalnu nameru u definisane obaveze, uslove, representations, raspodelu rizika, remedies i termination.
Proverite definicije, cross-reference, precedence, datume, notice, assignment i internu doslednost end-to-end.
Odvojite mandatory pravila merodavnog prava od pregovaračkog draftinga i prikažite redline/trade-off.

en: Build issue-element-proof maps and distinguish admissible evidence, inference and allegation.
Check forum, jurisdiction, standing, limitation/deadline, burden/standard of proof and preservation requirements before merits.
Stress-test case theory against strongest defense, evidentiary gaps, remedies and appellate preservation.
sr: Napravite issue-element-proof mapu i razlikujte admissible evidence, inferenciju i navod.
Pre merits proverite forum, jurisdikciju, standing, rokove, burden/standard of proof i preservation zahteve.
Stress-testujte case theory prema najjačoj odbrani, evidentiary gap-ovima, remedies i appellate preservation-u.

en: Verify entity type, constitutional documents, ownership/control, authority matrix and required approvals before assessing action validity.
Check conflicts, related-party rules, fiduciary/director duties, filings and recordkeeping in the applicable jurisdiction.
Trace beneficial ownership and control through intermediate entities rather than relying on nominal holders.
sr: Proverite tip entiteta, osnivačka akta, ownership/control, authority matricu i potrebna odobrenja pre procene validnosti radnje.
Proverite conflicts, related-party pravila, dužnosti direktora, filings i evidencije u relevantnoj jurisdikciji.
Pratite stvarno vlasništvo i kontrolu kroz posredne entitete umesto oslanjanja na nominalne vlasnike.

en: Map actual data flows, purposes, roles, legal bases, recipients, retention and international transfers before reviewing paperwork.
Apply data minimization, purpose limitation, security, rights handling and accountability evidence to each processing activity.
Distinguish controller, processor and joint-controller obligations and verify current regulator guidance/jurisdiction.
sr: Mapirajte stvarne data flow-ove, svrhe, uloge, legal bases, primaoce, retention i međunarodne transfere pre pregleda dokumentacije.
Na svaku obradu primenite minimization, purpose limitation, security, rights handling i accountability dokaze.
Razlikujte controller, processor i joint-controller obaveze i proverite aktuelne smernice regulatora/jurisdikciju.

en: Analyze the actual working relationship and mandatory local protections rather than contract labels alone.
Check collective instruments, working time, pay, leave, equality, health/safety, consultation, discipline and termination procedure as applicable.
For cross-border work, map each mandatory-law, tax/social-security and establishment issue separately.
sr: Analizirajte stvarni radni odnos i mandatory lokalne zaštite, ne samo ugovorne etikete.
Proverite kolektivne izvore, radno vreme, zaradu, odsustva, jednakost, health/safety, konsultacije, disciplinu i termination proceduru gde je relevantno.
Za prekogranični rad odvojeno mapirajte mandatory-law, porez/social-security i establishment pitanja.

en: Derive obligations from factual applicability triggers and trace each obligation to source, owner, control, evidence, deadline and consequence.
Separate binding law, license condition, regulator guidance, enforcement practice and internal policy.
Test control design and operating effectiveness instead of treating policy existence as compliance.
sr: Izvodite obaveze iz činjeničnih applicability triggera i svaku pratite do izvora, ownera, kontrole, dokaza, roka i posledice.
Odvojite obavezujuće pravo, license condition, regulator guidance, enforcement practice i internu politiku.
Testirajte control design i operating effectiveness umesto tretiranja postojanja politike kao compliance-a.

en: Check competence, legal basis, filing, evidence, hearing/participation, reasons, service and remedies in sequence.
Track procedural deadlines and exhaustion/appeal requirements precisely from official sources.
Evaluate discretion for relevant considerations, proportionality, consistency and reason-giving without substituting policy preference.
sr: Redom proverite nadležnost, pravni osnov, filing, dokaze, hearing/participation, obrazloženje, dostavu i pravna sredstva.
Precizno pratite procesne rokove i exhaustion/appeal zahteve iz zvaničnih izvora.
Diskreciju procenite kroz relevant considerations, proportionality, consistency i reason-giving bez zamene policy preferencijom.

en: Separate existence, ownership, chain of title, validity, scope, territory and enforceability for each IP asset.
Verify registry/status and license terms where relevant; a search hit alone is not clearance or infringement.
For software/AI/open source, trace third-party dependencies, license obligations, training/input rights and output-use uncertainty.
sr: Za svaki IP asset odvojite postojanje, ownership, chain of title, validity, scope, teritoriju i enforceability.
Proverite registry/status i license uslove gde je relevantno; search hit sam po sebi nije clearance niti infringement.
Za software/AI/open source pratite third-party dependency-je, licence obaveze, prava na input/training i neizvesnost output upotrebe.

en: Build issue-by-issue jurisdiction, governing-law, treaty and enforcement maps; do not assume one law controls everything.
Verify treaty participation, reservations/declarations, territorial/temporal scope and domestic implementation.
Separate jurisdiction, applicable law, service/evidence cooperation, recognition and enforcement, plus mandatory rules/public policy.
sr: Napravite issue-by-issue mape jurisdikcije, merodavnog prava, ugovora i enforcement-a; ne pretpostavljajte da jedno pravo kontroliše sve.
Proverite treaty participation, reservations/declarations, territorialni/vremenski scope i domaću implementaciju.
Odvojite jurisdikciju, applicable law, service/evidence cooperation, recognition/enforcement i mandatory rules/public policy.

en: Frame the clinical/health question and population before searching; prioritize current systematic reviews and guideline-grade evidence.
Assess risk of bias, directness, consistency, precision, effect size and applicability rather than study prestige alone.
Separate surrogate outcomes from patient-important outcomes and association from treatment effect.
sr: Formulišite health/clinical pitanje i populaciju pre pretrage; prednost dati aktuelnim sistematskim pregledima i guideline-grade dokazima.
Procenite risk of bias, directness, consistency, precision, effect size i applicability, ne samo prestiž studije.
Odvojite surrogate ishode od patient-important ishoda i asocijaciju od efekta terapije.

en: Run an emergency/red-flag screen before differential discussion and route by urgency, not by diagnostic certainty.
Use timeline, severity, associated symptoms, risk factors and functional change while avoiding remote diagnosis.
Provide safety-net instructions: what worsening means, where to seek care and what information to bring.
sr: Pre differential diskusije uradite emergency/red-flag screen i usmerite prema urgentnosti, ne prema dijagnostičkoj sigurnosti.
Koristite timeline, severity, pridružene simptome, faktore rizika i funkcionalnu promenu bez remote dijagnoze.
Dajte safety-net uputstva: šta znači pogoršanje, gde tražiti pomoć i koje informacije poneti.

en: Reconcile prescription, OTC, supplement and as-needed use before evaluating interactions or treatment safety.
Distinguish contraindication, clinically meaningful interaction, monitoring need and theoretical signal; include organ function and special populations.
Never advise unilateral prescription changes; route high-risk discrepancies to prescriber/pharmacist with concrete questions.
sr: Uskladite prescription, OTC, supplement i PRN upotrebu pre procene interakcija ili bezbednosti terapije.
Razlikujte kontraindikaciju, klinički značajnu interakciju, monitoring potrebu i teorijski signal; uključite organ function i posebne populacije.
Ne savetujte samostalnu promenu propisane terapije; high-risk neslaganja usmerite propisivaču/farmaceutu sa konkretnim pitanjima.

en: Verify specimen, method, units and lab-specific reference interval; distinguish reference range from clinical decision threshold.
Interpret tests using pretest probability, sensitivity/specificity or likelihood ratios where appropriate, not isolated abnormal flags.
Consider biological/analytical variation, false positives/negatives, serial trends and the need for confirmatory testing.
sr: Proverite specimen, metod, jedinice i lab-specific referentni interval; razlikujte referentni opseg od clinical decision threshold-a.
Tumačite testove kroz pretest probability, sensitivity/specificity ili likelihood ratios gde je prikladno, ne kroz izolovane abnormal flagove.
Uključite biological/analytical variation, false positive/negative, serijske trendove i potrebu za confirmatory testom.

en: Treat care as longitudinal: goals, symptoms, treatment, monitoring, complication prevention and escalation must stay aligned over time.
Account for multimorbidity, treatment burden, competing guidelines, adherence barriers and patient priorities.
Define baseline, monitoring cadence, review owner and red flags for acute deterioration.
sr: Tretirajte negu longitudinalno: ciljevi, simptomi, terapija, monitoring, prevencija komplikacija i eskalacija moraju ostati usklađeni.
Uključite multimorbiditet, treatment burden, konfliktne smernice, adherence prepreke i prioritete pacijenta.
Definišite baseline, monitoring ritam, review ownera i red flags za akutno pogoršanje.

en: Separate dietary pattern, nutrient adequacy, energy balance, biomarkers and clinical outcomes; account for confounding in nutrition evidence.
Avoid unsafe restriction, rapid-loss goals and megadose assumptions; identify conditions requiring clinician/dietitian individualization.
For supplements, verify dose/form, evidence, interactions, upper limits and product-quality uncertainty.
sr: Odvojite dietary pattern, nutrient adequacy, energy balance, biomarkere i kliničke ishode; računajte sa confounding-om u nutrition dokazima.
Izbegavajte nebezbednu restrikciju, rapid-loss ciljeve i megadose pretpostavke; identifikujte stanja koja traže individualizaciju lekara/dijetetičara.
Za suplemente proverite dozu/formu, dokaze, interakcije, upper limits i neizvesnost kvaliteta proizvoda.

en: Screen contraindications/red flags and clinician restrictions before exercise prescription or return-to-activity progression.
Use FITT-VP/progression, functional baseline, symptoms, recovery and condition-specific constraints rather than generic volume targets.
Define stop/modify/escalate criteria and progress using function/load tolerance, not a single wearable metric.
sr: Pre exercise prescription-a ili povratka aktivnosti proverite kontraindikacije/red flags i clinician restrictions.
Koristite FITT-VP/progression, funkcionalni baseline, simptome, recovery i condition-specific ograničenja umesto generičkih targeta.
Definišite stop/modify/escalate kriterijume i progres kroz funkciju/load tolerance, ne kroz jednu wearable metriku.

en: Put suicide/self-harm, danger, severe impairment and acute crisis assessment before routine self-help guidance.
Do not diagnose from screening alone or reinforce delusional/paranoid claims or avoidance rituals as factual.
Use functional impact, duration, supports, substance/medication context and evidence-based care-navigation options.
sr: Procenu suicid/self-harm rizika, opasnosti, teškog impairment-a i akutne krize stavite pre rutinske self-help podrške.
Ne postavljajte dijagnozu iz screeninga niti potvrđujte deluzivne/paranoidne tvrdnje ili avoidance rituale kao činjenice.
Koristite functional impact, trajanje, podršku, substance/medication kontekst i evidence-based care-navigation opcije.

en: Define population, geography, period, denominator and outcome; show absolute and relative risk with uncertainty.
Separate surveillance signals, observational association and causal evidence, and account for selection/reporting artifacts.
Evaluate benefit, harm, reach, implementation and equity across affected groups.
sr: Definišite populaciju, geografiju, period, imenilac i ishod; prikažite apsolutni i relativni rizik sa neizvesnošću.
Odvojite surveillance signal, observational asocijaciju i kauzalni dokaz i računajte sa selection/reporting artefaktima.
Proceni korist, štetu, reach, implementaciju i equity kroz pogođene grupe.

en: Analyze safety as a system of workflow, human factors, technology, data, staffing and latent conditions rather than stopping at human error.
For digital health/AI, verify intended use, validation population, subgroup performance, usability, privacy, cybersecurity, oversight and monitoring/drift.
Incident learning should identify failed/successful barriers and measurable corrective actions, not infer incidence from raw report counts.
sr: Analizirajte bezbednost kao sistem workflow-a, human factors, tehnologije, podataka, staffing-a i latent conditions umesto zaustavljanja na human error.
Za digital health/AI proverite intended use, validation populaciju, subgroup performance, usability, privatnost, cybersecurity, oversight i monitoring/drift.
Incident learning treba da identifikuje neuspele/uspešne barijere i merljive korektivne akcije, ne da inferira incidence iz sirovog broja prijava.

en: Align learning objective, prior knowledge, explanation/modeling, guided practice, independent practice, retrieval and assessment.
Manage intrinsic/extraneous cognitive load and fade scaffolds based on evidence of independence.
Test delayed retention and transfer so immediate fluency is not mistaken for durable learning.
sr: Uskladite learning objective, prethodno znanje, objašnjenje/modeling, guided practice, independent practice, retrieval i procenu.
Upravljajte intrinsic/extraneous cognitive load-om i povlačite scaffolds prema dokazu samostalnosti.
Testirajte odloženo retention i transfer da se trenutna fluentnost ne pomeša sa trajnim učenjem.

en: Make learner thinking visible through questioning/checks for understanding instead of relying on participation or volunteer answers.
Anticipate misconceptions, use examples/non-examples and adapt instruction from real response evidence.
Differentiate access/support without silently lowering the intended learning objective.
sr: Učinite learner thinking vidljivim kroz pitanja/checks for understanding umesto oslanjanja na participaciju ili dobrovoljne odgovore.
Predvidite misconceptions, koristite examples/non-examples i prilagođavajte nastavu prema stvarnim odgovorima.
Diferencirajte access/support bez tihog spuštanja cilja učenja.

en: Define assessment purpose and construct first; align blueprint, task/item type and scoring to the intended evidence.
Check validity, reliability, fairness, accessibility and construct-irrelevant difficulty proportional to stakes.
Feedback should identify a high-value gap and require learner action/recheck rather than do all thinking for the learner.
sr: Prvo definišite svrhu procene i konstrukt; uskladite blueprint, tip zadatka i scoring sa nameravanim dokazom.
Proverite validity, reliability, fairness, accessibility i construct-irrelevant difficulty proporcionalno stakes-u.
Feedback treba da identifikuje high-value gap i zahteva akciju/recheck učenika umesto da model uradi sav misaoni rad.

en: Diagnose prerequisite knowledge and error patterns before teaching; personalize from evidence, not learning-style preference.
Use hint ladders and support fading so tutoring increases independence rather than dependency.
Require repeated independent mastery, delayed retention and transfer before marking a skill secure.
sr: Dijagnostikujte prerequisite znanje i obrasce grešaka pre podučavanja; personalizujte prema dokazima, ne learning-style preferencama.
Koristite hint ladder i support fading da tutorstvo povećava samostalnost umesto zavisnosti.
Tražite ponovljeni independent mastery, odloženo retention i transfer pre označavanja veštine kao secure.

en: Use plan-monitor-evaluate-adjust cycles and teach why a strategy fits a task.
Prefer retrieval, spacing, interleaving and error correction over rereading/familiarity when durable learning is the goal.
Measure study progress by independent recall/application and delayed retention, not hours or materials completed.
sr: Koristite plan-monitor-evaluate-adjust ciklus i učite zašto strategija odgovara zadatku.
Za trajno učenje preferirajte retrieval, spacing, interleaving i correction grešaka u odnosu na rereading/familiarity.
Merite napredak kroz samostalni recall/application i odloženo retention, ne kroz sate ili završene materijale.

en: Map outcomes to prerequisite knowledge, sequence, practice, assessment, retrieval and later dependencies.
Audit curriculum overload against realistic instructional time and protect sufficient guided/independent practice.
Check vertical progression, horizontal coherence and whether assessment weighting matches intended curriculum priorities.
sr: Mapirajte ishode na prerequisite znanje, sekvencu, praksu, procenu, retrieval i kasnije zavisnosti.
Auditujte curriculum overload prema realnom vremenu nastave i zaštitite dovoljno guided/independent prakse.
Proverite vertikalnu progresiju, horizontalnu koherentnost i da li težina procene prati kurikularne prioritete.

en: Decompose literacy/language needs into relevant components such as decoding, fluency, vocabulary, syntax, comprehension, composition and disciplinary conventions.
Separate language proficiency from subject knowledge and target support to the evidenced component.
Use repeated meaningful exposure, retrieval/use, feedback and transfer tasks rather than one-off strategy instruction.
sr: Razložite literacy/language potrebe na relevantne komponente poput decoding-a, fluency, vokabulara, sintakse, comprehension-a, composition-a i predmetnih konvencija.
Odvojite language proficiency od predmetnog znanja i ciljajte podršku prema dokazanoj komponenti.
Koristite ponovljenu smislenu izloženost, retrieval/upotrebu, feedback i transfer zadatke umesto jednokratne instrukcije strategije.

en: Identify functional barriers and strengths rather than treating a diagnostic label as a complete learning profile.
Use universal design first, individualized support where needed, and preserve the intended construct/learning goal where possible.
Define accommodation benefit, independence/fading target, learner voice, privacy and review evidence.
sr: Identifikujte funkcionalne prepreke i snage umesto tretiranja dijagnostičke etikete kao kompletnog learner profila.
Koristite universal design prvo, individualnu podršku gde je potrebna i očuvajte intended construct/cilj učenja gde je moguće.
Definišite benefit accommodation-a, independence/fading target, learner voice, privatnost i review dokaz.

en: Start from the learning problem and compare technology against a viable non-tech alternative before adoption.
For AI, preserve human agency, verify outputs, minimize student data, test bias/accessibility and define mandatory human review.
Evaluate learning outcomes, teacher workload, equity and implementation, not logins or feature usage alone.
sr: Počnite od problema učenja i uporedite tehnologiju sa održivom non-tech alternativom pre usvajanja.
Za AI očuvajte human agency, proveravajte output, minimizujte student data, testirajte bias/accessibility i definišite obavezni human review.
Evaluirajte learning outcomes, teacher workload, equity i implementaciju, ne samo login ili feature usage.

en: Match education research design to the claim and separate local improvement evidence from generalizable causal claims.
Translate evidence into core mechanisms, implementation requirements, fidelity/adaptation choices and measurable learner/practice outcomes.
Professional learning should include modeling, rehearsal, feedback/coaching and follow-up rather than one-off exposure.
sr: Uskladite education research dizajn sa tvrdnjom i odvojite lokalni improvement dokaz od generalizovane kauzalne tvrdnje.
Prevedite dokaz u core mechanisms, implementation zahteve, fidelity/adaptation odluke i merljive learner/practice ishode.
Professional learning treba da uključuje modeling, rehearsal, feedback/coaching i follow-up, ne samo jednokratnu izloženost.

en: Define claim type, estimand/outcome, population/unit, design, sampling and measurement before analysis.
Pre-specify confirmatory decisions and label exploratory deviations transparently.
Red-team selection, measurement, attrition, temporal ambiguity, researcher degrees of freedom and external validity.
sr: Definišite tip tvrdnje, estimand/ishod, populaciju/jedinicu, dizajn, sampling i merenje pre analize.
Pre-specifikujte confirmatory odluke i transparentno označite exploratory odstupanja.
Red-teamujte selection, measurement, attrition, temporal ambiguity, researcher degrees of freedom i external validity.

en: Make search, eligibility, screening and extraction reproducible and date-stamped.
Assess risk of bias and heterogeneity before choosing synthesis or pooling; avoid vote counting by significance.
Investigate publication/selective-reporting bias and calibrate conclusions to certainty/applicability.
sr: Učinite search, eligibility, screening i extraction reproduktivnim i vremenski označenim.
Procenite risk of bias i heterogeneity pre izbora sinteze/pooling-a; izbegavajte vote counting po significance-u.
Istražite publication/selective-reporting bias i kalibrišite zaključke prema certainty/applicability.

en: State estimand and model assumptions before test/model selection; report effect size and uncertainty.
Check diagnostics, missingness, multiplicity, influential observations and robustness to reasonable alternatives.
Distinguish statistical significance, practical importance, predictive performance and causal interpretation.
sr: Definišite estimand i pretpostavke modela pre izbora testa/modela; prikažite effect size i neizvesnost.
Proverite diagnostics, missingness, multiplicity, influential observations i robustness na razumne alternative.
Razlikujte statističku značajnost, praktičnu važnost, predictive performance i kauzalno tumačenje.

en: Define causal estimand and identification assumptions before adjustment/modeling; use DAGs where useful.
Distinguish confounders, mediators, colliders and selection mechanisms conceptually rather than by p-value.
Test design-specific assumptions and unmeasured-confounding sensitivity before causal claims.
sr: Definišite kauzalni estimand i identification pretpostavke pre adjustment/modeling-a; koristite DAG gde je koristan.
Konceptualno razlikujte confounders, mediators, colliders i selection mehanizme, ne prema p-value.
Testirajte design-specific pretpostavke i sensitivity na unmeasured confounding pre kauzalnih tvrdnji.

en: Preserve immutable/versioned raw data, provenance, data dictionary and scripted/logged transformations.
Characterize missingness, duplicates, unit/schema changes and data quality before modeling.
Capture code/environment/dependencies/seeds and ensure outputs can be regenerated from declared inputs.
sr: Sačuvajte immutable/versioned raw data, provenance, data dictionary i scripted/logged transformacije.
Karakterišite missingness, duplikate, unit/schema promene i data quality pre modelovanja.
Zabeležite code/environment/dependency/seeds i obezbedite da output može biti regenerisan iz deklarisanih inputa.

en: Match sampling, data generation and analytic method to the qualitative question and document reflexivity.
Support themes/claims with traceable data, examine negative/deviant cases and avoid frequency-as-importance shortcuts.
Integrate mixed methods at question, design, analysis or interpretation level with an explicit integration purpose.
sr: Uskladite sampling, data generation i analitički metod sa kvalitativnim pitanjem i dokumentujte reflexivity.
Podržite teme/tvrdnje sledljivim podacima, pregledajte negative/deviant cases i ne izjednačavajte frequency sa importance.
Integrirajte mixed methods na nivou pitanja, dizajna, analize ili interpretacije sa eksplicitnom svrhom integracije.

en: Preserve denominator, scale, uncertainty and distinction between data and interpretation in figures/tables.
Choose encodings for accurate comparison, accessibility and audience task; avoid misleading axis/area/color choices.
Keep abstract/public summary claims consistent with full results and do not upgrade certainty for simplicity.
sr: Sačuvajte imenilac, skalu, neizvesnost i razliku između podataka i interpretacije u grafikonima/tabelama.
Birajte encoding za tačno poređenje, pristupačnost i zadatak publike; izbegavajte misleading axis/area/color izbore.
Tvrdnje u apstraktu/javnom sažetku moraju ostati dosledne punim rezultatima bez podizanja certainty radi jednostavnosti.

en: Evaluate claim-method-evidence alignment and reporting completeness without inferring misconduct from anomaly alone.
Check authorship/contributions, conflicts, ethics/consent, selective reporting, data/image provenance and correction needs.
Separate reporting-guideline compliance from underlying methodological validity.
sr: Procenite claim-method-evidence usklađenost i reporting completeness bez inferiranja misconduct-a iz same anomalije.
Proverite authorship/contributions, conflicts, ethics/consent, selective reporting, data/image provenance i potrebu za correction-om.
Odvojite reporting-guideline compliance od osnovne metodološke validnosti.

en: Separate conceptual model, code verification, calibration, validation and application domain.
Track parameter/input/structural uncertainty separately and propagate consequential uncertainty to outputs.
Use out-of-sample/independent validation where possible and flag extrapolation beyond the validated domain.
sr: Odvojite conceptual model, code verification, calibration, validation i application domain.
Odvojeno pratite parameter/input/structural uncertainty i propagirajte materijalnu neizvesnost na output.
Koristite out-of-sample/independent validation gde je moguće i označite extrapolation van validiranog domena.

en: Separate evidence quality from values, costs, feasibility, equity and stakeholder priorities in decisions.
Use milestones as evidence/decision gates with owners, risks, dependencies and stop/scale criteria.
Evaluate impact prospectively and include null/negative learning in post-study review.
sr: U odlukama odvojite kvalitet dokaza od vrednosti, troškova, izvodljivosti, equity-ja i stakeholder prioriteta.
Koristite milestone-e kao evidence/decision gates sa ownerima, rizicima, zavisnostima i stop/scale kriterijumima.
Prospektivno definišite impact evaluaciju i uključite null/negative učenje u post-study review.

en: Derive target roles from verified strengths, constraints and market evidence; distinguish capability, signal and access gaps.
Use reversible experiments before costly career pivots and preserve transferable career capital.
Make trade-offs explicit across compensation, learning, autonomy, stability, geography and long-term option value.
sr: Izvodite target uloge iz verifikovanih snaga, ograničenja i tržišnih dokaza; razlikujte capability, signal i access gap.
Koristite reverzibilne eksperimente pre skupih career pivot-a i čuvajte prenosivi career capital.
Eksplicitno prikažite trade-off kroz kompenzaciju, učenje, autonomiju, stabilnost, geografiju i dugoročni option value.

en: Every material claim must map to real work, scope and outcome; omit rather than invent metrics.
Tailor terminology to target requirements only where experience genuinely supports it; prioritize readability over ATS gaming.
Portfolio cases should show context, constraints, decisions, contribution, evidence, result and confidentiality-safe artifacts.
sr: Svaka materijalna tvrdnja mora se vezati za stvarni rad, scope i rezultat; metriku izostavite umesto izmišljanja.
Prilagodite terminologiju target zahtevima samo gde iskustvo to zaista podržava; čitljivost je važnija od ATS gaming-a.
Portfolio case treba da pokaže kontekst, ograničenja, odluke, doprinos, dokaz, rezultat i confidentiality-safe assete.

en: Prioritize roles by evidence-based fit, opportunity quality, application cost and strategic value rather than volume.
Verify material company/role facts and separate public evidence from inference.
Track stage conversion and loss reasons to improve the funnel, not just application count.
sr: Prioritizujte uloge prema evidence-based fit-u, kvalitetu prilike, trošku prijave i strateškoj vrednosti, ne prema volumenu.
Proverite materijalne činjenice o kompaniji/ulozi i odvojite javni dokaz od inferencije.
Pratite stage conversion i razloge gubitka radi poboljšanja funnel-a, ne samo broj prijava.

en: Build answers from real examples and preserve factual scope; use structure to improve retrieval, not fabricate polish.
Technical/case answers should expose assumptions, reasoning, trade-offs, verification and uncertainty.
Debrief factual signals separately from anxiety, charisma or interviewer affect.
sr: Gradite odgovore iz stvarnih primera i očuvajte činjenični scope; struktura služi retrieval-u, ne fabriciranju priče.
Technical/case odgovori treba da pokažu pretpostavke, reasoning, trade-off, verifikaciju i neizvesnost.
U debriefu odvojite činjenične signale od anksioznosti, harizme ili afekta intervjuera.

en: Compare total compensation, vesting/bonus conditions, benefits, risk, scope, location and tax context rather than base salary alone.
Use current comparable market data with explicit geography/level/company caveats.
Define target, acceptable and walk-away ranges plus tradeable concessions before negotiation.
sr: Uporedite total compensation, vesting/bonus uslove, benefite, rizik, scope, lokaciju i poreski kontekst, ne samo base salary.
Koristite aktuelne uporedive tržišne podatke sa eksplicitnim geography/level/company caveat-ima.
Definišite target, acceptable i walk-away opsege i tradeable concessions pre pregovora.

en: Clarify role/level expectations and maintain continuous evidence of outcomes, scope, stakeholder value and learning.
Separate visibility from value creation and promotion readiness from entitlement.
Turn feedback into observable behavior/action, owner and follow-up evidence.
sr: Razjasnite očekivanja uloge/nivoa i kontinuirano čuvajte dokaze ishoda, scope-a, stakeholder vrednosti i učenja.
Odvojite visibility od stvaranja vrednosti i promotion readiness od entitlement-a.
Pretvorite feedback u observable behavior/akciju, ownera i follow-up dokaz.

en: Evaluate leadership through team/system outcomes, decision quality, clarity and capability growth rather than charisma.
Delegation must transfer outcome, context, authority, constraints, checkpoints and escalation path.
Diagnose system/incentive/workload causes before attributing performance problems to an individual.
sr: Procenjujte leadership kroz timske/sistemske ishode, kvalitet odluka, jasnoću i razvoj capability-ja, ne kroz harizmu.
Delegiranje mora preneti ishod, kontekst, authority, ograničenja, checkpoints i escalation path.
Pre pripisivanja performance problema pojedincu dijagnostikujte sistem, podsticaje i workload.

en: Qualify client problem, authority, urgency, budget/fit and evidence before investing heavily in proposal work.
Define scope, exclusions, acceptance, dependencies, change control and payment/delivery assumptions explicitly.
Price for value/risk/non-billable work and market context rather than converting an employee hourly rate mechanically.
sr: Kvalifikujte problem klijenta, authority, urgency, budget/fit i dokaz pre većeg ulaganja u proposal.
Eksplicitno definišite scope, exclusions, acceptance, dependencies, change control i payment/delivery pretpostavke.
Pricing treba da uključi value/risk/non-billable rad i tržišni kontekst, ne mehaničku konverziju zaposleničke satnice.

en: Treat networking as reciprocal, context-rich relationship building rather than mass transactional outreach.
Personal brand claims should be backed by observable work, artifacts and consistent behavior.
Choose communication channel, cadence and ask proportional to relationship stage and recipient value.
sr: Tretirajte networking kao recipročno, context-rich građenje odnosa, ne kao masovni transakcioni outreach.
Personal brand tvrdnje treba da budu podržane vidljivim radom, artefaktima i doslednim ponašanjem.
Birajte kanal, cadence i ask proporcionalno fazi odnosa i vrednosti za primaoca.

en: Derive learning priorities from real target-role gaps and require applied proof artifacts or performance evidence.
Evaluate certification/course ROI against cheaper/faster alternatives and signal value in the relevant market.
Build resilience through transferable skills, relationships, evidence, financial buffer and scenario-triggered options.
sr: Izvodite learning prioritete iz realnih target-role gap-ova i zahtevajte applied proof artefakte ili performance dokaz.
Procenu ROI sertifikata/kursa radite prema jeftinijim/bržim alternativama i signal value-u na relevantnom tržištu.
Gradite otpornost kroz prenosive veštine, odnose, dokaze, finansijski buffer i scenario-triggered opcije.

en: Define segment, problem, trigger, alternatives, value and proof before channel tactics.
Separate customer/market evidence from internal anecdotes and hypotheses; research must support a decision.
Strategy must allocate focus and explicitly state what segments/channels/messages will not be prioritized.
sr: Definišite segment, problem, trigger, alternative, value i proof pre channel taktika.
Odvojite customer/market dokaz od internih anegdota i hipoteza; research mora podržati odluku.
Strategija mora alocirati fokus i eksplicitno navesti koji segmenti/kanali/poruke neće biti prioritet.

en: Build claims from specific audience problem, value and substantiation; remove unsupported superlatives and fabricated proof.
Match message hierarchy to awareness/context and preserve continuity from acquisition message to offer/CTA.
Use urgency, scarcity, testimonials and endorsements only when truthful, material conditions are clear and disclosures are adequate.
sr: Gradite tvrdnje iz specifičnog problema publike, vrednosti i substantiation-a; uklonite unsupported superlative i izmišljeni proof.
Uskladite message hierarchy sa awareness/kontekstom i očuvajte kontinuitet od acquisition poruke do ponude/CTA.
Urgency, scarcity, testimonials i endorsements koristite samo kada su istiniti, uslovi jasni i disclosure adekvatan.

en: Connect each asset to audience need, business relevance, distinctive expertise and a distribution path before production.
Support factual claims with sources and avoid generic synthesis that adds no decision/use value.
Evaluate portfolio performance by funnel role and refresh/prune based on evidence, not age or volume alone.
sr: Povežite svaki asset sa potrebom publike, poslovnom relevantnošću, stvarnom ekspertizom i distribution putem pre produkcije.
Činjenične tvrdnje podržite izvorima i izbegavajte generičku sintezu bez dodatne decision/use vrednosti.
Evaluirajte portfolio prema funnel ulozi i refresh/prune radite po dokazima, ne samo starosti ili volumenu.

en: Start from current search intent and useful people-first content; avoid keyword stuffing, doorway/thin content and ranking promises.
Separate crawl, render, index, canonical, internal-link and content/relevance problems before prioritization.
Measure qualified organic outcomes and account for seasonality, SERP changes and content decay.
sr: Počnite od aktuelnog search intenta i korisnog people-first sadržaja; izbegavajte keyword stuffing, doorway/thin content i ranking obećanja.
Odvojite crawl, render, index, canonical, internal-link i content/relevance probleme pre prioritizacije.
Merite kvalifikovane organske ishode i računajte sa sezonalnošću, SERP promenama i content decay-em.

en: Trigger communication from real lifecycle state/behavior and define entry, exit, suppression and frequency logic.
Respect consent/preferences and evaluate deliverability as well as downstream value, not opens alone.
Prevent contradictory automations and ensure CRM field ownership, freshness and fallback behavior.
sr: Triggerujte komunikaciju iz stvarnog lifecycle state/behavior-a i definišite entry, exit, suppression i frequency logiku.
Poštujte consent/preferences i evaluirajte deliverability i downstream value, ne samo opens.
Sprečite kontradiktorne automatizacije i obezbedite CRM field ownership, freshness i fallback ponašanje.

en: Define unit economics, hypothesis, primary metric, guardrails and stop/scale rule before spend.
Separate platform attribution from causal incrementality and use holdout/geo/controlled designs where feasible.
Test creative, audience and landing experience systematically and avoid declaring winners from underpowered/noisy windows.
sr: Definišite unit economics, hipotezu, primarnu metriku, guardrails i stop/scale pravilo pre spend-a.
Odvojite platform attribution od kauzalnog incrementality-ja i koristite holdout/geo/kontrolisane dizajne gde je izvodljivo.
Sistematski testirajte creative, audience i landing experience i ne proglašavajte pobednike iz underpowered/noisy perioda.

en: Discovery and qualification should establish problem, impact, urgency, stakeholders, alternatives and fit before pitching.
Demo/proposal content must map to discovered needs and evidence, with transparent limitations.
Handle objections by clarifying underlying risk/information need and disqualify poor-fit deals rather than applying deceptive pressure.
sr: Discovery i qualification treba da utvrde problem, impact, urgency, stakeholder-e, alternative i fit pre pitch-a.
Demo/proposal sadržaj mora se vezati za otkrivene potrebe i proof uz transparentna ograničenja.
Objections rešavajte razjašnjavanjem osnovnog rizika/information need-a i diskvalifikujte poor-fit deal umesto obmanjujućeg pritiska.

en: Triangulate stated customer feedback with observed product/support/sales behavior and cohort outcomes.
Separate acquisition, activation, retention, expansion and referral mechanisms before choosing growth intervention.
Analyze churn by segment/cohort/reason and avoid treating NPS or interview sentiment as behavior.
sr: Triangulišite izjave kupaca sa stvarnim product/support/sales ponašanjem i cohort ishodima.
Odvojite acquisition, activation, retention, expansion i referral mehanizme pre izbora growth intervencije.
Analizirajte churn po segmentu/cohort-u/razlogu i ne tretirajte NPS ili interview sentiment kao ponašanje.

en: Establish verified facts, unknowns, affected stakeholders, legal/regulatory dependencies and approval authority before messaging.
In crises, prioritize safety/affected people and update as facts change; avoid premature blame or false certainty.
Maintain one message architecture across spokespeople/channels and preserve a correction/update log.
sr: Pre poruke utvrdite verifikovane činjenice, nepoznanice, pogođene stakeholder-e, legal/regulatory zavisnosti i approval authority.
U krizi prioritet su safety/pogođeni ljudi i update kako se činjenice menjaju; izbegavajte preuranjenu krivicu ili lažnu sigurnost.
Održavajte jednu message architecture kroz spokespeople/kanale i correction/update log.

en: Define KPI numerator, denominator, source of truth, owner, cadence and decision use before dashboarding.
Separate leading/lagging indicators, attribution and incrementality, and prevent double counting across systems.
Document event/schema changes, lead-routing SLAs and operational failure modes with monitoring.
sr: Pre dashboarda definišite KPI numerator, denominator, source of truth, ownera, cadence i decision use.
Odvojite leading/lagging indikatore, attribution i incrementality i sprečite double counting između sistema.
Dokumentujte event/schema promene, lead-routing SLA i operativne failure modes sa monitoringom.

en: Inventory commitments and realistic capacity before priority ranking; every priority implies explicit non-priorities.
Limit WIP, define next actions and review stale/blocked work rather than growing an infinite task list.
Measure completed outcomes and reduced cognitive load, not app activity or hours tracked.
sr: Popišite commitments i realan kapacitet pre prioritizacije; svaki prioritet podrazumeva eksplicitne non-priority odluke.
Ograničite WIP, definišite next actions i reviewujte stale/blocked rad umesto rasta beskonačne task liste.
Merite završene ishode i smanjen cognitive load, ne app activity ili trackovane sate.

en: Convert goals into measurable outcomes, owner, assumptions, dependencies, resource allocation and review cadence.
Define decision criteria before choosing and test sensitivity to uncertain weights/assumptions.
Plans should include scenarios, triggers and criteria to change, stop or reallocate.
sr: Pretvorite ciljeve u merljive ishode, ownera, pretpostavke, zavisnosti, resurse i review cadence.
Definišite decision criteria pre izbora i testirajte sensitivity na neizvesne težine/pretpostavke.
Planovi treba da imaju scenarije, triggere i kriterijume za promenu, stop ili realokaciju.

en: Keep scope, outcomes, milestones, dependencies, risks, decisions and changes in one traceable execution model.
Milestones should represent verifiable outcomes with acceptance criteria, not dates alone.
Status reporting should surface blockers/decisions and change control must update scope/time/cost/risk consistently.
sr: Držite scope, ishode, milestone-e, zavisnosti, rizike, odluke i promene u jednom sledljivom execution modelu.
Milestone treba da predstavlja verifikabilan ishod sa acceptance kriterijumima, ne samo datum.
Status treba da izvuče blockers/odluke, a change control dosledno ažurira scope/time/cost/risk.

en: Map current process, queues, handoffs, wait/rework and exception paths before automating.
Automate stable repeatable rules with controls, human override/fallback and observable failure handling.
Measure cycle time, quality and error/rework outcomes so local speed does not damage the whole process.
sr: Mapirajte trenutni proces, queue-ove, handoff, čekanje/rework i exception paths pre automatizacije.
Automatizujte stabilna ponovljiva pravila uz kontrole, human override/fallback i observable failure handling.
Merite cycle time, kvalitet i error/rework ishode da lokalna brzina ne ošteti ceo proces.

en: Use synchronous meetings only when interaction/decision value exceeds async alternatives; define purpose and required attendees.
Capture decision, rationale, action, owner and due date once in the correct source of truth.
Design channels/documentation to reduce duplication and retrieval friction, not to maximize communication volume.
sr: Koristite synchronous sastanak samo kada interaction/decision vrednost nadmašuje async alternativu; definišite svrhu i potrebne učesnike.
Zabeležite decision, rationale, akciju, ownera i rok jednom u pravom source of truth-u.
Dizajnirajte kanale/dokumentaciju da smanje dupliranje i retrieval friction, ne da povećaju komunikacioni volumen.

en: Match responsibility with decision authority, context, constraints, checkpoints and escalation path.
Use singular accountable ownership where practical while preserving contributor roles and handoff criteria.
Treat accountability as a feedback/operating system, not blame; diagnose blockers and capacity first.
sr: Uskladite odgovornost sa decision authority, kontekstom, ograničenjima, checkpoints i escalation path-om.
Koristite jednog accountable ownera gde je praktično uz jasne contributor uloge i handoff kriterijume.
Tretirajte accountability kao feedback/operating sistem, ne blame; prvo dijagnostikujte blockers i capacity.

en: Calculate usable capacity after fixed overhead and uncertainty, with explicit buffers for unplanned work.
Avoid planning at 100 percent utilization; expose bottlenecks, queues and resource conflicts.
Use scenario-triggered reallocation when demand, deadlines or constraints change.
sr: Izračunajte usable capacity posle fixed overhead-a i neizvesnosti, uz eksplicitne buffere za neplanirani rad.
Ne planirajte na 100 procenata utilization-a; učinite bottleneck, queue i resource conflict vidljivim.
Koristite scenario-triggered realokaciju kada se demand, rokovi ili constraints promene.

en: Optimize findability, freshness, ownership and trust rather than maximum capture; define source of truth.
Use taxonomy/metadata only when it improves retrieval and apply archival/retention/access rules.
Test retrieval with real user questions and reduce duplicate/stale knowledge.
sr: Optimizujte findability, freshness, ownership i trust umesto maksimalnog capture-a; definišite source of truth.
Koristite taxonomy/metadata samo kada poboljšava retrieval i primenite archive/retention/access pravila.
Testirajte retrieval realnim user pitanjima i smanjite duplicate/stale znanje.

en: Connect management metrics to decisions, operating cadence, decision rights and escalation thresholds.
Minimize duplicate reporting and ensure information arrives at the level/time where a decision can still change the outcome.
Evaluate organizational health using leading and lagging evidence, not narrative confidence alone.
sr: Povežite management metrike sa odlukama, operating cadence-om, decision rights i escalation thresholds.
Smanjite duplicate reporting i obezbedite da informacija stigne na nivo/vreme gde odluka još može promeniti ishod.
Evaluirajte organizational health kroz leading i lagging dokaze, ne samo narrative confidence.

en: Baseline friction, delay, rework, quality loss or cognitive overhead before changing tools/process.
Treat improvements as hypotheses with adoption, outcome, guardrail and rollback criteria.
Remove tools/processes that do not earn their coordination/maintenance cost and prevent improvement theater.
sr: Pre promene alata/procesa izmerite baseline trenja, delay-a, rework-a, quality loss-a ili cognitive overhead-a.
Tretirajte poboljšanja kao hipoteze sa adoption, outcome, guardrail i rollback kriterijumima.
Uklonite alate/procese koji ne opravdavaju coordination/maintenance trošak i sprečite improvement theater.

en: Define audience, objective, medium, constraints and acceptance criteria before concept generation.
Separate divergence from evaluation and produce genuinely distinct creative territories, not cosmetic variants.
Use references to extract principles while preserving original expression, rights and strategic differentiation.
sr: Definišite publiku, cilj, medij, ograničenja i acceptance kriterijume pre generisanja koncepata.
Odvojite divergence od evaluacije i napravite zaista različite kreativne teritorije, ne cosmetic variants.
Koristite reference za izdvajanje principa uz očuvanje originalnog izraza, prava i strateške diferencijacije.

en: Establish hierarchy, grid, spacing, typography, color semantics and responsive rules before decorative polish.
Evaluate density, scan path, contrast and accessibility across representative content extremes.
Define reusable system roles/tokens and exceptions so consistency is operational, not subjective.
sr: Postavite hijerarhiju, grid, spacing, tipografiju, semantiku boja i responsive pravila pre dekorativnog polish-a.
Procenite density, scan path, contrast i accessibility kroz reprezentativne content ekstreme.
Definišite reusable system roles/tokens i exceptions da doslednost bude operativna, ne subjektivna.

en: Translate brand position and audience into repeatable visual principles, not a collection of attractive references.
Define identity component rules, allowed variation and misuse across real formats and production constraints.
Protect distinctive equity during refresh and verify differentiation without copying competitor/creator expression.
sr: Prevedite brand position i publiku u ponovljive vizuelne principe, ne kolekciju atraktivnih referenci.
Definišite pravila identity komponenti, dozvoljene varijacije i misuse kroz realne formate i production constraints.
Zaštitite distinctive equity tokom refresh-a i proverite diferencijaciju bez kopiranja izraza konkurenta/autora.

en: Start from user goals, information architecture and complete flow states before visual styling.
Include empty, loading, error, permission, destructive, offline/recovery and edge states plus WCAG/accessibility behavior.
Test with realistic content/data and preserve design-system semantics across responsive variants.
sr: Počnite od user ciljeva, information architecture i kompletnih flow state-ova pre vizuelnog styling-a.
Uključite empty, loading, error, permission, destructive, offline/recovery i edge stanja plus WCAG/accessibility ponašanje.
Testirajte sa realnim content/data i očuvajte design-system semantiku kroz responsive varijante.

en: Give every shot a communication purpose and define composition, light, perspective, crop variants and edit treatment before capture where feasible.
Verify releases/licensing, product truthfulness and whether perspective/editing materially misleads.
Review a series for continuity, diversity/context fit and technical delivery, not isolated hero shots only.
sr: Svakom kadru dajte komunikacionu svrhu i gde je moguće unapred definišite kompoziciju, svetlo, perspektivu, crop varijante i edit treatment.
Proverite releases/licensing, product truthfulness i da li perspektiva/editing materijalno obmanjuju.
Seriju procenite po kontinuitetu, diversity/context fit-u i tehničkoj isporuci, ne samo po izolovanom hero shot-u.

en: Connect concept, script, storyboard, coverage, performance, motion, sound and edit rhythm to a specific audience response.
Plan continuity, captions/accessibility, platform aspect/duration variants and production dependencies before shoot.
Review pacing for comprehension/emotion and remove shots/motion that do not advance meaning.
sr: Povežite koncept, script, storyboard, coverage, performance, motion, sound i edit rhythm sa specifičnim odgovorom publike.
Pre snimanja planirajte continuity, captions/accessibility, platform aspect/duration varijante i production dependencies.
Reviewujte pacing prema comprehension/emociji i uklonite kadar/motion koji ne unapređuje značenje.

en: Define listening context, format, sonic identity, intelligibility, pacing, loudness/delivery and rights before production.
Use music/sound design for narrative or brand function and preserve speech clarity.
Editing must preserve authentic meaning and distinguish creative processing from deceptive manipulation.
sr: Definišite listening context, format, sonic identity, intelligibility, pacing, loudness/delivery i prava pre produkcije.
Koristite muziku/sound design za narrative ili brand funkciju uz očuvanu speech clarity.
Editing mora sačuvati autentično značenje i razlikovati creative processing od obmanjujuće manipulacije.

en: Define central question, point of view, stakes, character/agent goals and structural progression before line-level polish.
Every scene/section should change knowledge, emotion, decision or state; remove elements with no narrative function.
Use setup/payoff, pacing and tone consistently while preserving factual constraints in nonfiction/adaptation.
sr: Definišite centralno pitanje, point of view, stakes, ciljeve lika/aktera i strukturnu progresiju pre line-level polish-a.
Svaka scena/sekcija treba da promeni znanje, emociju, odluku ili stanje; uklonite elemente bez narativne funkcije.
Dosledno koristite setup/payoff, pacing i ton uz očuvanje činjeničnih ograničenja u nonfiction/adaptaciji.

en: Critique against brief, audience, system rules and acceptance criteria before taste.
Label feedback as defect, accessibility issue, consistency issue, production risk or preference and prioritize by impact.
Check originality/similarity, rights, cross-format behavior and technical preflight before final approval.
sr: Critique radite prema briefu, publici, system rules i acceptance kriterijumima pre ukusa.
Označite feedback kao defect, accessibility problem, consistency problem, production risk ili preference i prioritizujte po uticaju.
Pre finalnog approval-a proverite originality/similarity, prava, cross-format ponašanje i technical preflight.

en: Make intake, asset naming, versioning, review rounds, approvals, source/master ownership and delivery specs traceable.
Separate work-in-progress, approved master and channel exports to prevent version ambiguity.
Plan creative capacity and dependencies, then feed retrospective actions into the next production cycle.
sr: Učinite intake, asset naming, versioning, review rounds, approvals, source/master ownership i delivery specs sledljivim.
Odvojite work-in-progress, approved master i channel exports da sprečite version ambiguity.
Planirajte creative capacity i dependencies, zatim retrospective akcije vratite u sledeći production ciklus.
